inputs.text: The Taoiseach was in Limerick bragging about housing tenancies rising even after his government forced those March 1 rules on landlords for six-year leases. He dismissed the obvious spike in eviction notices and homelessness, but the number of people in emergency accommodation has gone up again across the nation. This is exactly what happens when government interferes too much in private rental agreements, attacking property rights and family stability. We must get back to personal responsibility and market signals to maintain order instead of letting bureaucrats tear down the foundations of our stable society.

output.main_topic: Criticism of rental regulations and their alleged effects on housing and homelessness
